entry.title: Ever Play - HiFi Music Player
entry.content:
Discount Information

In-App Purchases

  • Hi-Res & DSD & Visualizer：₺1.999,99 → ₺147,99 [₺147,99 ~ ₺1.999,99]

All Price Information

Price：Free

In-App Purchases

  • Full Function Pack：₺82,99
  • Real-time DSD Conversion：₺99,99
  • Hi-Res & DSD & Visualizer：₺147,99

Application Description

Bring your local, cloud and NAS music into one Hi-Res player. Ever Play gives you control of your own library, with lossless audio, DSD playback, offline caching and detailed output options for external DACs. Built for listeners who collect FLAC, ALAC, WAV, APE or DSD files and want to enjoy them without depending on a streaming catalog. Everplay supports all popular formats including Hi-Res ones. One of the most important feature of Everplay is that it support DSD(up to 11.2MHz，aka. DSD256) playback, in term of PCM and DoP. When PCM mode is selected, DSD is converted to and output as PCM. When DoP mode is selected, DSD is outputted as DSD over PCM.(Connected device must be DoP-compatible to this mode, otherwise, DSD will be outputed as PCM even DoP mode is selected.) Everplay support up to 384kHz/32bit music file and upsampling output Mode, you can select custom output sample rate to playback. It can automatically choose the max support format to playback, so you never need to worry about output device change. Everplay support Wi-Fi transfer, iTunes files sharing and Airdrop. Through Wi-Fi Transfer, you can share music files between computer and Everplay app with browser. • Google Drive • 115 Drive • Aliyun Drive • Baidu Yun Drive • One Drive • SMB1/2/3 • WebDAV • Tencent WeiYun • 123 Drive • dropbox • navidrome • pCloud • FLAC(MQA), APE, WAV, ALAC(M4A), AIFF, AIF, MP3, WMA, OGG, AAC,DTS • SACD(ISO), DSF, DFF(DSD64, DSD128 and DSD256 support both PCM and DoP output mode) • CUE(Sheet) [Music Management and Easy Transfer] • WiFi Music Transfer (Http) • iTunes Files Sharing • Playlist Management • Files Management • Airdrop [Advanced Features] • Support Aliyun which beat with music,It's one of the most advanced visualizer in the App Store. • Playback Hi-Res audio source up to 32bit/384kHz • Playback DSD audio source up to 11.2MHz • Visualizer • Hundred settings of EQ with random play • Random EQ for each song when playing • Searching songs • Display song and connected device information • Upsampling function • Sleep timer • Disable Auto-lock Screen • Auto-download Album/Artist Image(On/OFF) • DSD to PCM • Dop(DSD over PCM) • Custom Output Sample Rate • Redesign the Player Interface and Interaction • Online lyrics • Gapless playback • Resample rate Algorithm • Variable Playback Rate • Fast Forward and Fast Backward • A→B repeat play • Siri Play • Shortcut Play • iPadOS Multiple Windows Support URL Scheme: FancyMusicPlayer Subscription name:
